IconDesc.SourceString: 拖车鞘
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Octowpus

IconDesc.SourceString: 由「环」各大部门共同建立的巨大建筑，可监测当地的维特海默值波动，并在数值异常时立刻发出警示，以便各部门及时采取应对措施。因其绚丽的外观和地标性，现已成为各大城市的热门打卡点。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The Circle’s many departments built massive structures like this. They monitor local Wertheimer Index fluctuations and issue timely Anomaly warnings. Their striking design has made them landmarks and popular attractions in major cities.

IconDesc.SourceString: 遍布世界各地的传送装置，由「环」的直属机关「尤克阿什庭」负责管理。在海特洛市的街头传说中，废弃的红色电话亭里有时会传出诡异的铃声，无辜的过路人就这样消失在茫茫黑雾中……当然，都市传说总是存在一些美好的艺术加工，不过体验过的异能者们多次向「环」提议改良传送方式，毕竟被吞食，消化，然后再排……咳咳，反刍，总之是很糟糕的体验。「尤克阿什庭」暂未回复。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Teleportation devices, scattered across the globe and managed by the Circle's direct agency, the Yggash Court. There is an urban legend in the streets of Hethereau about an abandoned red Phone Booth that sometimes emits a spooky ringtone, and just like that, innocent passersby vanish into the vast black fog… Of course, urban legends always have a bit of artistic flair to them. However, those who have experienced teleportation have repeatedly suggested to the Circle that they improve the method. After all, being swallowed, digested, and then… ahem, regurgitated, is quite an unpleasant experience. The Yggash Court has yet to respond.

IconDesc.SourceString:
何人惊扰她的安眠？
何人牵起她的裙袂？
何人……愿共舞一曲？
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Who dares disturb her slumber?
Who lifts the hem of her dress?
Who… wishes to dance with her?

IconDesc.SourceString: 亲爱的乘客，欢迎您乘坐海特洛市异象列车「幽灵号」。为保证您与其他乘客的乘车安全，请您严格遵守《幽灵号乘客守则》，文明乘车。祝您旅途愉快。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Dear passengers, welcome aboard Hethereau's Anomaly Metro "Ghost Train." To ensure your safety and that of other passengers, please strictly follow the "Ghost Train Passenger Manual" and ride courteously. We wish you a pleasant journey.

IconDesc.SourceString: 亮晶晶的宝石，逃不过鸟类的眼睛。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: No shiny gem escapes a bird's eye.

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下实用型公寓之一，紧邻商业街的便捷房源。维纳公寓采用Loft设计，既具开阔空间感又拥有高性价比，精巧布局满足日常生活所需，是都市人安心落脚的理想之选。基础家电一应俱全，拎包入住，生活从此轻松无忧。优越地段让你尽享城市便利，步行即达购物与美食地带，开启摩登生活新篇章！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Wiener Apartments – Smart Living by Leon Estate Group. A practical, loft-style apartment right next to the city's bustling commercial street. Designed for comfort and value, the open layout makes the most of your space while meeting everyday needs with ease. Fully equipped with essential home appliances—just move in and start living. Whether you're shopping, dining, or just enjoying city life, it's all just steps away. Wiener Apartments offer the perfect launchpad for your next chapter in modern urban living.

IconDesc.SourceString: 以现代美学重构乡居生活，配备智能家居与庭院景观，为都市人提供一处身心归栖的雅致居所。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A modern take on country living, blending smart home comforts with a landscaped courtyard to create an elegant escape from city life for both body and mind.

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下高端公寓之一，桥间地优质房源。黄金地段，配套设施齐全，个性化设计，全城风光尽收眼底。更有专属的异象「管家」来负责生活的方方面面，无论是举办派对还是私人休闲，都能满足你对高品质生活的所有想象！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: One of the high-end apartments under Leon Estate Group, premium housing in Bridge Crossings. Prime location, complete facilities, personalized design, and a panoramic city view. The place comes with an exclusive anomaly butler to manage all aspects of your life. Whether you're here to host a party or for private leisure, this place is sure to meet all of your expectations for a quality life!

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下高端平层甄选之作——「天景空馆」，地处米格尔区商圈核心区位，与地标上晴塔咫尺相望。全套精装设计，打造开阔明亮的居住空间，重新定义扁平化别墅生活新范式。超高得房率确保每一寸空间价值，无遮挡采光设计让阳光与风景常伴。多元商业配套步行即达，完美满足养宠、餐饮、文化等品质生活所需。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Skyview Halls—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is situated in the heart of Miguel District's commercial hub, within view of the iconic Hethereau Skytower. Featuring full premium decorations that create spacious, bright living areas, it redefines the concept of villa living in a flat layout. The exceptional space efficiency ensures value in every square inch, while the unobstructed design welcomes natural light and scenic views year-round. With diverse commercial amenities within walking distance, it perfectly accommodates quality lifestyle needs including pet care, dining, and cultural activities.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛知名特聘设计师重磅钜作——「天骏公阁」，位居大厦最高层。臻造顶层复式，扇形全景布局，配套开放式私享泳池，供您纵览都会天际线，漫享云端生活美学。居室内独创空中车库，可由汽车电梯直达，为您的爱车留出焦点席位，成就人车共栖的先锋生活艺术。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A landmark work by one of Hethereau's renowned commissioned designers, Pegasus Residence occupies the building's top floor. This meticulously crafted penthouse duplex features a sweeping fan-shaped layout, panoramic city views, and a private open-air pool, inviting you to enjoy a refined lifestyle above the clouds. Inside, an original sky garage is directly accessible by automotive elevator, giving your beloved car a place of honor and creating an avant-garde living experience where driver and machine coexist.

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下高端平层典范——「金都云邸」，坐落于新赫兰德核心地带。金都云邸精心打造高层精装空间，房屋格局开放阔绰，诠释都市雅致生活。电梯直抵库勒涅步行街，尽揽新赫兰德潮流精粹；卡美洛、奇诺双主干道环伺，海特洛都会盛景近在咫尺。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Golden Capital—Leon Estate Group's premium apartment selection—is located in the heart of New Herland. Golden Capital meticulously crafts elegant high-rise living spaces with open and spacious layouts that embody sophisticated urban living. With elevators providing direct access to Kyllene Promenade, residents can immerse themselves in New Herland's trendiest offerings, while the surrounding major arteries of Camelot and Keno Boulevards place the splendor of Hethereau's metropolitan landscape just steps away.

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下奢华别墅代表作——「峰林别墅」，傲踞绿墙坡最高点。峰林别墅采用开放式家庭布局，宽广恢弘空间设计，让您尽享从容生活。全景落地窗完整收录绿墙坡四季盛景，顶层卧室专享海特洛天界线独特风光。别墅配备超规格地上车库及度假级露天泳池，完美兑现您对「奢华」的全部想象。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Fenglin Villa, Leon Estate Group's flagship luxury villa. Stands proudly at the highest point of Green Wall Slope. Featuring an open-concept layout with spacious, magnificent design, Fenglin Villa allows you to enjoy life with effortless elegance. Floor-to-ceiling windows capture the full splendor of Green Wall Slope's seasons, while the master bedroom on the top floor offers exclusive views of Hethereau's unique skyline. The villa comes equipped with an oversized above-ground Garage and a resort-level outdoor swimming pool, perfectly delivering on every aspect of what you imagine "luxury" to be.

IconDesc.SourceString:
全桥间地最可靠的古董店，没有之一！
「珍贵古董 稀有异象 拒绝赝品 假一赔五……啊不是，是三……本店还接受异象事件委托，良心口碑，童叟无欺！」
以上内容，全部责任由伊波恩店主个人承担。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
The most reliable antique shop in all of Bridge Crossings, bar none!
"Precious antiques, rare anomalies, no counterfeits, fake items refunded five times… wait no, three times… We also accept anomaly case commissions, honest reputation, fair prices for all!"
The above content is the sole responsibility of the Eibon shop owner.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市最大的连锁书店，店内书籍从流行月刊漫画到晦涩难懂的专业书籍一应俱全，涵盖面非常广，几乎每一位顾客都能在这里找到心仪的书籍。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's largest bookstore chain offers a wide range of books, from popular monthly manga to obscure non-fiction, ensuring almost every customer a beloved piece.

IconDesc.SourceString: 这座火车站跳动着城市的脉搏。这里是故事的起点，也是归途的中转站。钢与光交织的站台上，每一声鸣笛，都为城市注入新的节奏与韵律。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: This train station pulses with the city's heartbeat. It is the starting point of stories and a transit station for return journeys. On the platform where steel and light interweave, each whistle injects new rhythm and melody into the city.

IconDesc.SourceString: 坐落于桥间地半角街的「菲林轨迹」，当地小有名气的照相馆，精湛的技艺吸引着远近慕名而来的人们，附近的街坊领居也早已习惯了它的存在。四季更迭，总有不同的面孔在此留下温柔的印记。一张张照片，如同一页页翻动的旧书，讲述着成长、团圆、离别和重逢的故事。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Located on Hankaku Street in Bridge Crossings, Film Orbit Studio is a locally renowned photo studio, attracting people from near and far with its exquisite craftsmanship. The surrounding neighborhood has long been accustomed to its presence. As seasons change, different faces leave gentle imprints here. Each photograph is like a page in an old book, telling stories of growth, reunion, parting, and encounter.

IconDesc.SourceString:
在很久以前，曾由一个行为举止都如花朵般端丽的典范望族家庭居住。据传，他们以高雅清净的生活方式掩盖其支离破碎的亲情关系……后来，维持在几乎未有半点「家丑」被泄露出来的悄无声息中……家族默默崩塌了。
因最后一位继承人的弃置，精心打造的庄园如今沦为一片荒芜。然而，最近又有人闻见从那深处传来馥郁花香……
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Long ago, a model noble family, graceful like flowers, lived here. Rumor has it they masked their fractured family ties with an elegant lifestyle… While maintaining a near-perfect facade without any "family scandal" being exposed… the family just silently collapsed.
Due to the abandonment by the last heir, the meticulously crafted manor has now fallen into ruin. However, recently, some have caught a whiff of a rich floral scent emanating from its depths…

IconDesc.SourceString: 只要钱到位，异象都不是问题！斯特利速递向您保证，无论何时何地，您的快递一定准时抵达！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: As long as the money is right, anomalies are not a problem! Sterry Express guarantees your delivery will arrive on time, anytime, anywhere!

IconDesc.SourceString:
海特洛市本地的综合教育机构。除传统教育科目和丰富的社团活动外，也推行了教授异象相关知识的新兴课程等。
但是，学校因遭受过异象事件（物理层面上）的重创，使得教职工在对待学生安全问题时往往态度严厉。与整体新潮开放的市风对比，该校校风显得谨慎、保守。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A local comprehensive educational institution of Hethereau. On top of traditional subjects and a variety of club activities, they are also the pioneers of anomalogy education.
However, due to the severe physical impact of an anomaly incident, the staff often adopt a strict attitude towards student safety issues. Compared to the overall trendy and open city atmosphere, the school's ethos appears cautious and conservative.

IconDesc.SourceString: 伊波恩的仓库。事实上基本只有塔吉多在使用，里面堆放着他稀奇古怪的发明。或许能在里面找到有用的东西。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Eibon's warehouse. In reality, it's basically only used by Taygedo, filled with his weird and wonderful inventions. You might be able to find something useful in there.

IconDesc.SourceString: 薄荷在异象管理局的办公室——话虽如此，这并不意味着整个办公室都属于薄荷，她的工位只有其中小小的一块。但总之，薄荷很欢迎你去她的办公室作客。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Mint's office at the Bureau of Anomaly Control—though that doesn't mean the entire office belongs to Mint, her workspace is just a small section of it. But in any case, Mint welcomes you to visit her office.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市首富「德沃夏克家族」的家藏馆，馆内陈列着从古董珍玩、艺术杰作到神秘异象的各类藏品。因为家族热心慈善事业，藏馆免费向全体市民开放，如今已成为海特洛市的知名旅游景点与打卡圣地。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The private collection hall of Hethereau's wealthiest family, the "Dvořák Family," displaying various collections ranging from antique treasures and artistic masterpieces to mysterious anomalies. Due to the family's dedication to charity, the collection hall is open to all citizens free of charge, and has now become a famous tourist attraction and photo spot in Hethereau.

IconDesc.SourceString:
可以消耗城市活力进行演出，根据演出结果获取方斯。营业时间为凌晨3点到15点。
经营多年的Livehouse。虽然场地不大，容纳人数有限，但因其价格亲民，颇受刚起步的乐队青睐。
「将散落天际的群星缀连成为熠熠生辉的星座，或许只需要一首歌的时间。」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Spend City Stamina to perform and earn Fons based on your results. Business Hours: 03:00 – 15:00.
A livehouse that's been in operation for many years. Although the venue has limited capacity, the affordable prices make it quite popular with up-and-coming bands.
"Connecting scattered stars across the sky into a brilliantly shining constellation might only take the time of a single song."

IconDesc.SourceString:
海特洛市基层治安巡查机构，主要负责与异象和异能者无关的治安事件及民生事务。无论是坑蒙拐骗、交通肇事，还是宠物离家出走、出门忘带钥匙、外卖没给餐具……治安官们都将恪尽职守，为市民全力以赴。
总之请牢记：有困难找治安所。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Hethereau's grassroots security patrol agency, primarily responsible for security incidents and civil affairs unrelated to anomalies and espers. Whether it's fraud and scams, traffic accidents, or pets running away from home, forgetting keys when going out, takeout orders missing utensils… the security officers will fulfill their duties and give their all for the citizens.
In short, please remember: when in trouble, find the Security Office.

IconDesc.SourceString: 卡佩大酒店定期召开的普通拍卖会，无硬性入门要求，只要带够方斯。有时候拍卖会上会出现一些特殊的拍品，或许会用得上。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Regular auctions held at The Kapé Grand Hotel with no strict entry requirements, just bring enough Fons. Sometimes special items appear at these auctions that might come in handy.

IconDesc.SourceString: 买房，找莱昂！质量过硬，绝不塌房！顶层豪宅，雅静庄园！各式房产，尽在莱昂！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Leon takes care of all your property concerns. Quality assured, no collapsing houses! Penthouse mansions, calming manors! Various properties, all at Leon!

IconDesc.SourceString: 知名汽车品牌「新越」的授权经销店，在此您可以享有一切新越品牌提供给顾客的优惠。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: An authorized dealership of the famous car brand "Novus", where you can enjoy all the benefits that Novus offers to customers.

IconDesc.SourceString: 改装？维修？来暴走玩家准没错！伯骑士一号，满足您的速度的一切渴望——或是让您的爱车变得和新的一样！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Mods? Repairs? Rampage Players got you on your seat! Knight One fulfills all your need for speed!

IconDesc.SourceString: 隶属于「零角实验室」的异象科技公司。其专利技术上至弧盘、收容装置等专业设备，下至「随心泥」等解压玩具，不仅重塑了异象猎人的生活方式，更让异象真正走进千家万户。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: An anomaly technology company affiliated with Zerogon Laboratory. Their patented technology ranges from professional equipment like Arcs and Containment Devices to stress-relief toys like the Imaginadough, not only reshaping the lifestyle of Anomaly Hunters but also bringing anomalies into every household.

IconDesc.SourceString: 若您陷入迷惘，魔女小姐可为您指出道路。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: If you ever feel lost… Witch can show you the way.

IconDesc.SourceString:
海特洛市为满足市民日常储物需要，推出的街头储物柜。由于其便利性，得到了市民们的推崇。
目前运营方正在尝试推出基于「一格」的多种衍生服务，如行李托运、衣物送洗等；储物柜的覆盖范围也在逐步扩大。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Street storage lockers launched by Hethereau to meet citizens' daily storage needs, praised for the convenience they offer.
The operators are currently trying to launch various derivative services based on the "Griddy" such as delivery and laundry services with ever-expanding coverage.

IconDesc.SourceString:
纳库佩达栖身的水池。
很久很久以前，这个公园以及喷泉池都还拥有着属于自己的「名字」。
纳库佩达定居于此后，一切都成为了纳库佩达的附属品。

纳库佩达就是一切！
——纳库佩达爱好者协会宣
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
The pool where Nacupeda dwells.
Long, long ago, this park and its fountain pool each had their own names.
After Nacupeda settled here, everything became mere extensions of Nacupeda.

Nacupeda is everything!
—Nacupeda Fans Club

IconDesc.SourceString: 「莱昂置业」旗下沿街商铺。遍布繁华商业街，交通便利，人流量大！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A street-side shop owned by Leon Estate Group, right in the heart of the busy commercial district. Easy access with convenient transportation and great traffic.

IconDesc.SourceString: 知名潮玩品牌专卖店，与「特工Z世代」、「邂逅～银月圆舞会」等多个ip均有联动，也因此备受年轻人们追捧，但即便喜欢的ip联动了，各位也要先吃饭再吃谷！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A well-known pop toy brand store with many collabs with popular IPs like "Gen Z" and "Moonlight—A Gala of Visions". But folks, remember, don't go broke just because you wanted every merch from your favorite show!

IconDesc.SourceString: 巨嘴包子店，街坊邻居都说好！早上来一个新鲜出笼的「巨嘴奶黄包」，那滋味！不过，食用之前一定要先确定它「冷静」下来了，不然可会被「咬」到哦！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Bigmouth Baozi, praised by locals! Start your morning with a fresh Bigmouth Custard Baozi, what a taste! But be sure it's "calm" before eating, or it might "bite" you!

IconDesc.SourceString: 咖啡豆的理想生长环境温度是15℃到24℃，9℃咖啡店，为到店的每一位客人提供当季最佳的咖啡豆。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The ideal growing temperature for coffee beans is between 15°C and 24°C. 9°C Coffee provides the best seasonal coffee beans to every guest who visits the shop.

IconDesc.SourceString: 桥间地小有名气的观赏鱼店，月亮湾对每一位喜爱、想要了解水产的客人敞开大门——当然，猫咪除外。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A well-known ornamental fish shop in Bridge Crossings. Luna Bay welcomes every guest who loves and wants to learn about aquatic life… so long as you are not a hungry cat.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市最大的连锁药妆店，竹氏百年老字号，现在不仅仅是医药！「夏日的晴空」联动面膜绝赞畅销中！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's largest pharmacy chain, the century-old brand of the Zhu family, now offers more than just medicine! "Clear Skies in Summer" facial masks are selling like hotcakes!

IconDesc.SourceString: 店面虽小，品类却齐全的老式报刊亭，是小众读物和旧书爱好者的好去处。若是能和店主成为朋友，或许能从他口中听到一些尘封的城市往事。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Though small in size, this old-fashioned newsstand has a complete selection and is a great spot for niche publications and used book enthusiasts. If you can become friends with the owner, you might hear some long-buried tales of the city from him.

IconDesc.SourceString: 方盒手机线下专卖店，我们保证您在线下拥有线上同样优惠且享有更优质的服务！所以，请来线下店吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Cubox Phone guarantees you the same discounts as online, with even better service in our storefronts! Come and pay us a visit!

IconDesc.SourceString: 作为一家唱片店，店长会为每一位热爱音乐的人提供服务……虽然有时会让他的猫代劳。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: In a record shop, of course the owner provides service to every music lover… although sometimes his cat does the job.

IconDesc.SourceString: 高人气的家庭餐厅，是附近学生聚餐休闲的不二之选。天大地大，吃饭最大！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A popular family restaurant, it is the top choice for nearby students to gather and relax. Nothing like some affordable delicacy!

IconDesc.SourceString:
「四季之味，一期一会。」
半角街小有名气的居酒屋，前大将千代婆婆的手艺深受附近居民的喜爱，而新任大将「卜多力」也没有辜负熟客们的信任，依然能让客人们吃到物美价廉，最合心意的美食。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
"Seasonal flavors, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter."
A well-known izakaya on Hankaku Street. Granny Chiyo's culinary skills are beloved by local residents, and the new Taishou, Budori, continues to win the trust of regulars, offering delicious and affordable meals.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市最受欢迎的糖果品牌线下门店，现在购买最新款「噗卡巧克力」还可参与绘莉最新人偶戏门票抽选！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's most popular candy brand's locations now offers a chance to win tickets to Ellie's latest puppet show with the purchase of the newest Puka Chocoa!

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市知名连锁便利店，便当、饮料、漫画等等商品一应俱全！24h营业，即使是夜间也能为您点起明灯。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's convenience store chain. Offers everything from bentos, drinks, to manga! Open 24 hours, lights up your nights!

IconDesc.SourceString: 作为最大的连锁快餐店……抱歉，刚刚在想炸鸡和薯条的事情……咔叽玛快食早已成为了市民生活中不可替代的……抱歉，又在想炸鸡和薯条的事情……
IconDesc.LocalizedString: As the largest fast-food chain… Sorry, just thinking about fried chicken and fries… Clicky Fast Food has long been an irreplaceable part of citizens' lives… Sorry, thinking about fried chicken and fries again…

IconDesc.SourceString: 喜爱诗与花的一对挚友开的花店。来「集山忘野」品一首诗，带走一束花吧，因为诗与花皆是生命中不可或缺之物。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A flower shop opened by two close friends who love poetry and flowers. Visit Hillside Blooms for a poem and take a bouquet with you… the indispensables in life.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市的连锁绿植店，创始人是一位狂热的植物爱好者和设计师，在嘈杂忙碌的都市中，植愈中的植物以自己特有的形态，平和、安静地生长着。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's plant shop chain. The founder is a passionate plant enthusiast and designer. In the bustling city, the plants in Lively Greens grow peacefully and quietly in their own unique ways.

IconDesc.SourceString: 深受异象们喜爱的一家宠物店，不善于人类交流却能与异象沟通的店长以及能读懂人心的异象，在别人眼中是「怪咖」的两位一起努力，给了许多无助的异象温暖的家。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A pet store loved by anomalies. Ran by a human who can understand anomalies, and an anomaly who can understand human. Two outsiders working together to provide a warm home for many.

IconDesc.SourceString: 个人经营的礼品店铺，店长总是情绪高亢的想要给每一个人惊喜，而「Oops！Chest」也成功实现了店长的想法，尽可能让每一个收到礼物的人都惊喜的叫出声。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A gift shop run by an individual, where the owner is always eager to surprise everyone. "Oops! Chest" successfully realizes the owner's idea, making everyone receiving a gift exclaim with joy.

IconDesc.SourceString: 藏在桥间地小巷深处的一家并不算知名的清吧。「螺丝起子」代表有说不出口的心事，那在店里的人们，又是否有藏在心中的故事？
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A not-so-famous quiet bar hidden deep in the alleys of Bridge Crossings. Screw Driver embodies unspoken thoughts. Could it be that the patrons here also harbor stories deep within their hearts?

IconDesc.SourceString: 上至三十年前风靡一时的横版过关游戏，下至目前暴热的街机游戏全包含的大型电玩城。传说如果能够一命通关电玩城内的所有游戏即可获得「无敌玩家」的称号！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A large arcade that includes everything from side-scrollers popular 30 years ago to today's hottest arcade games. Legend has it that if you can clear all the games in one go, your name will be carved onto the ultimate leaderboard as the "Invincible Player"!

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市知名快销时装品牌连锁门店，坚持将现代、简约自然、高品质且易于搭配的商品提供给消费者。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A well-known fast-fashion brand chain store in Hethereau, committed to providing consumers with modern, simple, natural, and high-quality products.

IconDesc.SourceString: 时尚品牌「猎鹰」线下专卖店，其时尚、独特的设计让品牌旗下的运动手表和手链成功引领潮流，备受年轻人追捧。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A storefront for Falcon, a fashion brand known for their stylish and unique designs which has successfully led the trend with its sports watches and bracelets, loved by young people.

IconDesc.SourceString:
作为高端影院，浮冰影院配备顶级音响系统与巨幅高清银幕，确保为每一位观众提供极致的视听盛宴。
「就算影片本身不尽如人意……至少我们的座椅睡起来比您家的沙发更舒服。」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
As a high-end cinema, Floe Cinema is equipped with top-tier sound systems and massive high-definition screens, ensuring an ultimate audiovisual feast for every audience member.
"Even if the movie itself isn't quite up to par… at least our seats are more comfortable to sleep in than your couch at home."

IconDesc.SourceString: 外出游玩，不想带着脏兮兮的衣服回去？初来乍到，没有可用的洗衣机？阴雨连绵，苦于衣服久久干不了？「V.i.B」，帮您解决一切问题！低价，高效，干净，吸尽污渍，烦恼一扫空！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Going on a trip and don't want to return with dirty clothes? Just arrived and no washing machine available? Continuous rain making it hard to dry clothes? "V.i.B" solves all your problems! Low cost, high efficiency, clean, and removes all stains, leaving no worries behind!

IconDesc.SourceString: 其貌不扬的二手电器店，单看店铺的装潢或许会让人怀疑这家店是否靠谱，但实际上该店不仅会帮你送货上门，七天内出现问题还可以无理由退货。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: An unremarkable used electronics store. The store's decor might make you question its reliability, but the store not only delivers to your doorstep, but also allows question-free returns within 7 days.

IconDesc.SourceString: 老旧的自行车能够修好，但旧时光和那些回忆却无法追回。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Old bicycles can be repaired, but the old times and memories cannot be recovered.

IconDesc.SourceString: 上了年头的老店，是附近街区居民买肉的不二之选，也正因此，每周二的特价日都像是一场战争……
IconDesc.LocalizedString: An old shop with years of history, the top choice for nearby residents to buy meat. Because of this, every Tuesday's discount day feels like a battle…

IconDesc.SourceString: 普通的连锁蔬菜店，每个人的身边都会有这样的店，或许有些人从来没有进去过，但是切记——「多吃蔬菜」。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A common vegetable chain, there's always one nearby. Though some may never have entered, they remember—"Eat more vegetables."

IconDesc.SourceString:
「勿忘我？作为一家水果店，这个名字是不是太像花店了？」
除了问价，店长每天最经常听到的就是这个问题。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
"Forget-me-not? Isn't that a better name for a flower shop?"
Besides asking for prices, this is the question the owner hears most often every day.

IconDesc.SourceString: 叫着看起来很像便利店的名字，但其实是一个水产店。店主大叔总是嚷嚷着要有一个「跟得上时代的名字」，因此「七海水产店」变成了「7-Oceans」。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A name that sounds like a convenience store, but it's actually a seafood shop. The owner used to babble about "having a name that keeps up with the times", and hence "Nanami Seafoods" became "7-Oceans".

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市有名的连锁豆腐店，其豆腐套餐有口皆碑，如果是带着饱餐一顿的想法来的客人一定不会失望！不过，如果是为了寻找「桥间地车神」的话，或许找错地方了……
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A famous tofu chain in Hethereau, known for its highly praised tofu set meals. Customers looking for a hearty meal won't be disappointed! However, if you're looking for the Bridge Crossings Drifter, you might be in the wrong place…

IconDesc.SourceString: 在繁杂的都市中，我们每个人都疲惫不堪地前进着。或许有时我们会迷失，到那时，就到这来一杯吧，因为这是迷失者们的休憩之地。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: In the bustling city, we all move forward exhausted. Sometimes we might get lost, and when that happens, come here for a drink, as this is a haven for the lost.

IconDesc.SourceString: 幸福就是一口美味的冰淇淋！Felicità Gelato，给您零下15摄氏度的幸福！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Happiness is a bite of delicious ice cream! Felicità Gelato, bringing you happiness at -15°C!

IconDesc.SourceString: BOMB！BOOM！BANG！「三重爆炸」热狗车，带给你视觉，嗅觉，味觉三方面的爆炸性冲击！（不是真的会爆炸！）
IconDesc.LocalizedString: BOMB! BOOM! BANG! Tri-Blast Hotdogs! Bringing explosives to your senses! (No real explosives invovled!)

IconDesc.SourceString: 上班上学哪有不疯的！这种时候怎能没有奶茶相伴？抽风猫，非常符合你的精神状态！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Work or school can be crazy! How can you not have crazy milk tea at crazy times like these? Crazy Cat is perfect for your mental state!

IconDesc.SourceString: 烧烤与音乐，Rolling Rock与Rock&Roll，来滚岩，一同度过一个疯狂的夜晚吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Barbecue and music, Rolling Stone & Rock and Roll! Come to Rolling Stone for a wild night!

IconDesc.SourceString: 专注于章鱼烧的小店，单论章鱼烧即使跟卜多力相比也不遑多让！招牌「大将军章鱼烧」正火热售卖中！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A shop focused on takoyaki, comparable even to Budoriya in terms of takoyaki! The signature Taishou Takoyaki is selling hot!

IconDesc.SourceString: 原是桥间地老字号店铺，现已在市内开设多家分店，同时开通全城外卖配送——即使是烤熟的鸭子也会飞！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Originally a long-established shop in Bridge Crossings, it has now opened multiple branches throughout the city and offers citywide delivery service. Even cooked ducks can fly!

IconDesc.SourceString: 桥间地知名的烘焙店，为了做出能让大家绽放出笑容的蛋糕而努力着，在附近的街区早已有了一批忠实顾客，心情不好时就来这里吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A renowned bakery in Bridge Crossings, striving to create cakes that bring smiles to everyone. It has already garnered a loyal customer base in the nearby streets. Feeling down? Come around!

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市小有名气的中古店，卖服饰、包包、家具、餐具、工艺品等各式各样的中古商品。别看老板外号「好人乔」，实际上本人巧舌如簧，店铺真假混杂售卖。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A well-known vintage shop in Hethereau selling various vintage items, like clothing, bags, furniture, tableware, and crafts. While "Good Joe" runs the place, the guy might just have some questionable ethics and business practices…

IconDesc.SourceString:
「如果能有一只这么能干的猫养着我的话……」
「这位客人，我们是拉面店不是猫咖，请不要随便摸主厨，谢谢。」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
"Man I hope I have a cat looking after me too…"
"Hey, this a ramen shop, not a cat cafe. Also, stop touching our chef."

IconDesc.SourceString:
物美价廉的副食品店，实惠到顾客怀疑人生。店主似乎格外热衷于举办特惠活动，打折理由数量之多，令友商同行瞠目结舌。
「今天天气真好，值得庆祝，全场五折！」
「今天天气不好，需要振奋，全场五折！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A specialty food store with great quality at low prices, so affordable that customers question reality. The owner seems exceptionally enthusiastic about holding sales events, with discount "reasons" that leave competitors speechless.
"The weather's so nice today, worth celebrating! Everything 50% off!"
"The weather's bad today, need some cheer! Everything 50% off!"

IconDesc.SourceString:
品类格外齐全的咖啡豆店。品牌创始「人」似乎从很多年前就开始钻研咖啡豆了，不仅海特洛市的居民爱光顾，连郊外野山中的一些异象也是店里的常客。
「你尊重时间，岁月就会回报你。」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A coffee bean shop with an exceptionally comprehensive selection. The brand's founder seems to have been researching coffee beans for many years now, and not only do Hethereau residents love to visit, but some anomalies from the mountains outside the city are also regular customers.
"Respect time, and the years will reward you."

IconDesc.SourceString:
主打亲民路线的披萨店，年轻人聚餐的好去处。
「招牌披萨五星推荐！配餐的通心粉也比想象中好吃，值得一试。不过探店时要注意：千万别问店员为什么披萨上不能放水果……就算是为了节目效果也别问！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A pizza shop that takes the affordable route, a great place for young people to dine together.
"Five-star recommendation for their signature pizza! The pasta side dish is also better than expected and worth a try. But when visiting, be careful: never ask the staff why you can't put fruit on pizza… don't ask even if it's for content!"

IconDesc.SourceString:
海特洛市最大的家居精品店。丰富多样的家居好物，让平平无奇的「房子」真正成为独一无二的「家」。
「不是超贵，是超规格！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Hethereau's largest home goods boutique. A rich variety of home essentials that turns a house into a home.
"It's not expensive, it's DeLuxur!"

IconDesc.SourceString:
数年前，海特洛市曾有一辆名为「碎雪」的异象冰淇淋车。她活泼开朗、爱讲故事，还总能做出最美味的冰淇淋，每一位小朋友都喜欢她。然而某天，为了回应远方城市小朋友的期待，「碎雪」和哥哥——热狗车「向阳」——一同驶离了这座城市，消失在了地平线上。那一天，海特洛的街巷间，处处都是失落的孩子。
于是，普普通通的冰淇淋车「碎雪」诞生了。虽然这里的冰淇淋是人工制作，营业员也不都擅长讲故事，但是那份熟悉的甜美滋味，还是填补了孩子们空落落的心。或许某一天，真正的异象「碎雪」会回到这座城市……也许永远不会。但可以确定的是，在每个炎热的日子里，这座城市都会拥有「碎雪冰淇淋」的清凉。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Years ago, Hethereau was home to an anomaly ice cream cart named Blizzi. She was lively and cheerful, loved telling stories, and could always make the most delicious ice cream. Every child in the city adored her. However, one day, to answer the hopes of children in a distant city, Blizzi and her brother—a hot dog cart named Sunni—drove away from the city together, disappearing beyond the horizon. That day, Hethereau's streets and alleys were filled with heartbroken children everywhere.
And so, an ordinary ice cream cart called "Blizzi" was born. Though the ice cream here is handmade and not all the staff are good at telling stories to kids, that familiar sweetness still fills the emptiness in the children's hearts. Perhaps someday, the real Blizzi will return to this city… or maybe she never will. But one thing is certain: on every hot day, this city will be blessed by the cool refreshment of Blizzi Ice Cream.

IconDesc.SourceString: 我听到了许多未被记载的故事，鲜活的故事，或许您可以去听听。请记得一切相遇，皆是注定。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: I have heard many stories that were never recorded, living stories… Perhaps you should go and listen to them. Remember, all encounters are destined.

IconDesc.SourceString: 可显示一定范围内的所有谕石，最多可同时存在3个。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Reveals all Oracle Stones within a certain range. A maximum of 3 can exist simultaneously.

IconDesc.SourceString: 可显示一定范围内的所有谕石，最多可同时存在3个。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Reveals all Oracle Stones within a certain range. A maximum of 3 can exist simultaneously.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛最大的出租车公司，拥有线上平台「雨燕出行」，持续为海特洛居民提供专业的出行服务。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The largest taxi company in Hethereau, operating the online platform Swift Travel, providing professional transportation services to Hethereau residents.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛最大的综合医院，以其完备的设施和精湛的医术，持续为海特洛市民提供高质量的医疗服务。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The largest general hospital in Hethereau, providing quality healthcare services to the citizens with its state-of-the-art facilities and exceptional medical expertise.

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛市德沃夏克财团旗下的商业银行。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A commercial bank under the Dvořák conglomerate in Hethereau.

IconDesc.SourceString: 一棵巨大的树木，生长在小山丘的顶端。人们相信如此特别的大树会拥有实现愿望的力量，因此常到树下许愿，久而久之，这棵树成为了一个景点。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A giant tree that grows atop a small hill. People believe that such a remarkable tree possesses the power to grant wishes, and so they often come to make wishes beneath its branches. Over time, the tree has become a popular attraction.

IconDesc.SourceString:
由海特洛市政发起，并主要由德沃夏克家族投资建设的海特洛地标性建筑，兼具讯号发射功能。
上晴塔全年开放，底层设有餐饮及文创区域，顶层设有观景平台和餐厅，是市民休闲的好去处，也是游客必打卡的景点之一。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A landmark of Hethereau, initiated by the city government and primarily funded by the Dvořák family. The tower also serves as a signal transmission facility.
Hethereau Skytower is open year-round. The lower floors feature dining and cultural creative spaces, while the top floor boasts an observation deck and restaurant. It is a popular leisure destination for citizens and a must-visit attraction for tourists.

IconDesc.SourceString: 福荫木附近的售卖点，出售许愿牌及相关衍生产品。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A vendor near the Fortune Shades, selling wishing plaques and related merchandise.

IconDesc.SourceString:
风平浪静的钓鱼点，是海特洛钓鱼高手们所青睐的场所。
不同的钓鱼点可以钓到的鱼有所不同，如果能正确地使用合适的鱼饵，可以更容易钓到想要的鱼。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A calm fishing spot favored by Hethereau's anglers.
Each spot attracts different fish, and using the right bait makes it easier to reel in your target catch.

IconDesc.SourceString: 根据海特洛市治安管理条例，对于扰乱公共秩序、屡教不改者，治安所有权将其移交拘留所，予以处罚。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: In accordance with the Hethereau Public Safety Ordinance, individuals who disturb public order and refuse to comply with repeated warnings may be transferred to a detention facility by the Security Office for punishment.

IconDesc.SourceString:
人气极高的女仆咖啡厅「小小麻雀」，不仅有元气满满的女仆提供服务，饮品和餐点也十分可口，因此广受好评。
麻将是店内的最大特色。可以约上好友来休闲放松，店内的女仆也会在得到邀请时参加客人的牌局，不过坐上麻将桌的她们就会卸下可爱的笑容，变为老练、专业、毫不留情的牌手……
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Little Sparrow is an extremely popular maid café known not only for its lively maids and delicious food and drinks, but also for its rave reviews across the board.
Mahjong is the café's signature attraction. Bring your friends for a relaxing time, and if you ask nicely, the maids might even join your game. Be warned: the moment they sit down at the mahjong table, those sweet smiles vanish, replaced by the steely focus of seasoned, ruthless players…

IconDesc.SourceString:
海特洛市德沃夏克财团旗下的商业银行总部。
电影《金库大劫案》爆火后，许多并不知名的劫匪开始对粉爪银行的金库蠢蠢欲动……虽然至今无人见到金库的大门，但有人嗅到了商机。
德沃夏克携手知名电影导演西涅莫·李推出大型综艺节目「粉爪大劫案」，一比一还原电影场景布置，沉浸式体验另一种生活，更为优胜者准备了丰厚奖励！只是听说一些「特别强大」的优胜者，似乎会登上一个奇怪的名单……
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
The headquarters of the commercial bank under the Dvořák conglomerate in Hethereau.
Ever since Vault Heist became a huge hit, many unknown criminals began coveting access to the vault of Pink Paws Bank… Though no one has yet seen the vault's entrance, there was nonetheless a business opportunity.
Dvořák teamed up with renowned film director Cinema Lee to launch the reality show, "Pink Paws Heist," featuring a one-to-one recreation of the movie's sets for an immersive experience, with generous rewards prepared for winners! However, rumor has it that some particularly capable performers might find their own names on a rather insidious list…

IconDesc.SourceString:
卡厄斯设置的传送锚点。
猎犬化为船锚，继而化为门扉。这是至今为止，卡厄斯对他的异能最为得意的运用。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A Teleport Anchor placed by Chaos.
The hound becomes an anchor, then a doorway. To this day, Chaos takes more pride in this use of his Esper Ability than any other.

IconDesc.SourceString: 妄图窃取时间的「负债者」，不过是在时间的仓鼠轮上徒劳地奔逃。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The "debtor" who seeks to steal time merely runs in vain upon time's hamster wheel.

IconDesc.SourceString: 强者无需身外之物。放下武器，能倚仗的唯有纯粹的力量。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The strong need no outside aid. Lay down your weapons—only raw strength will carry you through.

IconDesc.SourceString:
这世间异象林林总总——
有些已被记录，有些尚待发掘。
有些是真相的全貌，有些只是管中窥豹。

人们再怎么努力收集，档案永远缺几页。
不是疏忽，是有些东西还没来得及被归类，就已经在不起眼的角落里自行长出了枝叶。

你若在途中抬头，偶然瞥见那枝叶，不妨采撷一枝。
也不枉这场相逢的奇妙。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
The world is full of Anomalies of every kind—
some have been recorded, while others still wait to be found.
Some reveal the whole truth; others offer only a narrow glimpse.

No matter how hard people try to collect them all, the archive is always missing a few pages.
Not out of negligence. Some things take root in forgotten corners before anyone has time to classify them.

If, on your journey, you happen to look up and catch sight of such a branch, pluck it.
Then this curious encounter will not have been in vain.

IconDesc.SourceString: 床单是点缀着的华服，糖苹果是亮晶晶的宝剑，连摇摇晃晃的小木马都变成日行千里的良驹。在这里，一切天马行空的童年幻想都值得一根美味棒的奖励。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Bedsheets become royal robes, candy apples become glittering swords, and even a rocking horse can gallop a thousand miles. Here, every childhood fantasy earns a delicious reward.

IconDesc.SourceString:
一家由猫猫售货的报刊亭，主营业务是靠卖萌来推销积压的纸质报刊和书籍，只是比起卖萌，随书附赠的奖券似乎更让人心动。
「一份报纸仅售一条小鱼干……笨蛋！那样我们就倒闭得更快了啊！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A newsstand where clerks are cats. Its main business model is to use cute cats to sell magazines and books that don't sell well. But compared to the cute cats, the vouchers that come with the other items are more attractive to customers.
"One newspaper selling for one dried fish…! Dumb kitty, we'll shut down sooner if we do business like that!"

FT_teleport.Comment: 真红副本内传送门（条件显示）

IconDesc.SourceString:
「沃伦大陆的隐秘之处，古老的魔网相互联结，此等法阵便是为无法窥见魔网奥妙的愚钝之人准备的毫无美感的便捷移动方式。」
「……总之就是能传送对吧？」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
"In the hidden reaches of the Warren Continent, ancient arcane networks intertwine. This array is but an unsightly convenience, devised for dullards unable to glimpse the network's mysteries."
"…So it teleports, right?"

FT_shop_1.Comment: 真红场景商店类（如有多个就自己新增）

IconDesc.SourceString: 温暖的火苗抚慰着旅者的心灵，疲惫受伤的时候就回来举起薪火吧。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Warm flames soothe the traveler's heart. When weariness or wounds take hold, return and kindle the campfire.

IconDesc.SourceString: 不知何故，这片大陆上充斥着困难的特殊挑战。成功通过挑战，能收获丰富的奖励。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: For some reason, there are many difficult special challenges around the continent. Pass them to collect great rewards.

IconDesc.SourceString:
勇者一行人的营地。
无论多么波澜壮阔的冒险壮旅，都需要一个小小的避风港。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
The adventuring party's camp.
Even the grandest quest needs a humble safe haven.

IconDesc.SourceString: 勇者们武力与勇气的试炼之地。成功通过挑战，能收获丰富的奖励。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A trial of strength and courage for true heroes. Complete the challenge to earn generous rewards.

IconDesc.SourceString:
神秘莫测的异象桌游，会根据游玩者的个人特质定制沉浸式的冒险世界。
「永不重复的冒险体验，量身打造的幻想大陆，九百九十九夜等待着独属于你的一个梦。」
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A mysterious anomaly board game that creates immersive worlds based on the characteristics of its participants.
"No two adventures alike. A fantasy world built just for you. 999 Nights awaits the dream that only you can dream."

IconDesc.SourceString: 碰碰运气！来碰碰运气！运气一定会站在你这边！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Come on! Come try your luck! Luck is on your side!

IconDesc.SourceString: 传说中连赤龙都赞不绝口的绵绵旅店，绵绵点评中的评分居高不下。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Even the Crimson Dragon sings the praises of the legendary Fuzzy Inn, which still holds an excellent rating on Fuzzy Reviews.

IconDesc.SourceString: 冒险游戏中最常见的设定，它似乎比勇者本人更能掌控其命运。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A classic fixture of adventure games. Somehow, it seems to decide the hero's fate more often than the hero does.

IconDesc.SourceString:
可在此处存放或提取仓库中的物品。
出于未知原因，这个世界上所有仓库似乎都是相连的。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Store your belongings here, or retrieve them from the warehouse.
By some unknown art, every warehouse in this world seems to be connected.

IconDesc.SourceString: 让眼力过绵的鉴定绵帮你看看！哦哦哦~是稀有的好宝贝咩！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Let the Appraisal Fuzzy with a good eye take a look for you! Ooooh! It's a rare find!

IconDesc.SourceString: 遍布世界各地的传送装置，由「环」的直属机关「尤克阿什庭」负责管理。在海特洛市的街头传说中，废弃的红色电话亭里有时会传出诡异的铃声，无辜的过路人就这样消失在茫茫黑雾中……当然，都市传说总是存在一些美好的艺术加工，不过体验过的异能者们多次向「环」提议改良传送方式，毕竟被吞食，消化，然后再排……咳咳，反刍，总之是很糟糕的体验。「尤克阿什庭」暂未回复。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Teleportation devices, scattered across the globe and managed by the Circle's direct agency, the Yggash Court. There is an urban legend in the streets of Hethereau about an abandoned red Phone Booth that sometimes emits a spooky ringtone, and just like that, innocent passersby vanish into the vast black fog… Of course, urban legends always have a bit of artistic flair to them. However, those who have experienced teleportation have repeatedly suggested to the Circle that they improve the method. After all, being swallowed, digested, and then… ahem, regurgitated, is quite an unpleasant experience. The Yggash Court has yet to respond.

IconDesc.SourceString: 建成已久的沙滩排球场，海特洛市民的休闲圣地。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A well-established beach volleyball court, a popular leisure spot for Hethereau residents.

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚集团建设的室内排球场，设施专业完备，深受各类排球赛事的青睐。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: An indoor volleyball court built by the Orichalcos Group. Its professional-grade facilities and amenities make it quite a popular venue for volleyball events of all kinds.

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚下属新建项目施工现场。安全施工，准时交付！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Construction site for a new Orichalcos project. Guaranteed safe construction and on-time delivery!

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚下属新建项目施工现场。安全施工，准时交付！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Construction site for a new Orichalcos project. Guaranteed safe construction and on-time delivery!

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚下属新建项目施工现场。安全施工，准时交付！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Construction site for a new Orichalcos project. Guaranteed safe construction and on-time delivery!

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚下属新建项目施工现场。安全施工，准时交付！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Construction site for a new Orichalcos project. Guaranteed safe construction and on-time delivery!

IconDesc.SourceString: 奥利哈刚下属新建项目施工现场。安全施工，准时交付！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Construction site for a new Orichalcos project. Guaranteed safe construction and on-time delivery!

IconDesc.SourceString: 海面上漂散着许多货物，有人正为之一筹莫展。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Cargo is scattered across the water. Someone could really use a hand.

IconDesc.SourceString: 在炎炎夏日和海风来一场竞速！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Race through the summer heat and ocean breeze!

IconDesc.SourceString: 海特洛最负盛名的船店。主理人柊光曾是职业改装技师，但逐渐厌倦了改装车辆的生活，于是转而学习造船技术，创立了以自己的名字命名的船只品牌。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Hethereau's most renowned boat shop. Its proprietor, Hiiragi Hikari, was once a professional vehicle modification technician. After growing tired of the trade, he turned to shipbuilding and eventually founded a boat brand bearing his own name.

IconDesc.SourceString: 亲爱的乘客，欢迎乘坐海特洛市异象列车「幽灵二号」特别环线：「千站环线」，本次旅途较长，请随时注意自身状态，安全乘车。祝您旅途愉快。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Dear passengers, welcome aboard Hethereau's Anomaly Metro, the "Ghost Train." This is the special Endless Circle service. It's a long ride, so keep an eye on your condition and stay safe along the way. We hope you enjoy the journey.

IconDesc.SourceString: 借一身童话，赴一场奇遇。新的童话主角，请书写未完的故事吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Step into a fairy-tale look and set off on an adventure. You're the hero now—go write the rest of your story!

IconDesc.SourceString: 把礼物带回家，下一次想念噗卡时，就打开这份小小的纪念吧。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Bring home a little souvenir, and whenever you miss the Puka, just take it out for a look.

IconDesc.SourceString: 一杯咖啡，一段安静的时光，让心愿在香气中慢慢醒来。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A cup of coffee, a quiet moment—let your wishes awaken with the aroma.

IconDesc.SourceString: 让脚步暂时停下来，给自己一杯奶茶的时间吧。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Rest your feet and treat yourself to a cup of milk tea.

IconDesc.SourceString: 不论是特别的日子，还是平凡的一天，总有一份甜点恰到好处——蛋糕是最小单位的游乐园。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Whether it's a special occasion or just another day, there's always room for the perfect treat. After all, a cake is a little amusement park all its own.

IconDesc.SourceString: 快乐有很多种温度，而这里的幸福，恰好是冰冰凉凉的。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Happiness comes in many temperatures. Here, it's best served ice-cold.

IconDesc.SourceString: 这里有各种各样的甜蜜选择，足够为每一段奇遇添上一份好滋味。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: With so many sweet treats to choose from, every adventure is bound to taste a little better.

IconDesc.SourceString: 美味已就位，快乐急需能量支持！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The food is ready, and every adventure needs fuel!

IconDesc.SourceString: 美味适合分享，快乐需要相聚。来这里和重要的人一起吃顿饭吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Good food is made for sharing, and happiness is better together. Come enjoy a meal with someone special!

IconDesc.SourceString: 这里是乐园旅途的小小中转站，不论遇到任何问题，都可以来这里寻求帮助哦！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: This little stopover keeps your Pukaland adventure on track. Whatever you need, we're always here to help!

IconDesc.SourceString: 「熔岩镇镇长邀请所有冒险家来淘金！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The mayor of Lavaton invites all adventurers to try their luck in the gold rush!

IconDesc.SourceString: 听从磁力指引，让甜蜜大摆圈在空中划出完美弧线！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Follow the magnetic pull and trace a perfect arc through the sky on the Punchulum Ride!

IconDesc.SourceString: 「本次糖仙子圆舞会将在空中举行！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The Pixies Waltz takes to the skies!

IconDesc.SourceString: 「震惊！噗卡乐园的所有糖果都被章鱼船长掠夺了！急需糖果超人帮助！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Breaking news! Captain Octo has stolen all the candy in Pukaland! Calling all candy heroes!

IconDesc.SourceString: 传闻趣奇诡乐屋中藏着许多来自不敢在外面的乐园露面「暗影来客」，它们想留下每一个闯入者，你只能依靠勇气与智慧才能平安离开！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Rumor has it that Spooky Cookies is home to many Shadow Guests who never show themselves anywhere else in Pukaland. They want to keep every intruder there forever, so you'll need both courage and wits to make it out safely!

IconDesc.SourceString: 听说花篱深处藏着许多秘密？想要找到它们，可不能只靠运气！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: They say countless secrets lie beyond the hedges. Finding them takes more than luck!

IconDesc.SourceString: 拿起手枪，向心动目标发起挑战！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Grab your pistol, pick your target, and take your best shot!

IconDesc.SourceString: 命中命中！找准角度，投出属于你的幸运飞镖！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Bullseye! Find the perfect angle and let your lucky dart fly!

IconDesc.SourceString: 「熔岩镇镇长邀请所有冒险家来淘金！」
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The mayor of Lavaton invites all adventurers to try their luck in the gold rush!

IconDesc.SourceString: 号外号外！噗仔们偷偷藏进洞里啦！快拿起小锤，把调皮的小家伙们找出来吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Extra! Extra! The Pukaboos have snuck back into their holes! Grab a mallet and whack those mischievous little rascals!

IconDesc.SourceString: 蓄势待发中~挑战摇摇欲坠的噗仔们，看看谁能创造最精彩的一击！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The Pukaboos are wobbling and ready! Take them on and see who can land the most spectacular hit!

IconDesc.SourceString: 考验记忆力的时刻到了！记住每一个秘密，翻开未知的盒子探索惊喜吧。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Time to test your memory! Memorize what's inside, then open the mystery boxes and uncover the surprises!

IconDesc.SourceString: 转动魔法幸运盘，看看今天的好运会落在哪里！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Give The Magic Spin a whirl to see where your good luck lands!

IconDesc.SourceString: 听说这里能看见最美的烟火哦。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: They say you can see the most dazzling fireworks from right here!

IconDesc.SourceString: 悠扬乐曲、梦幻旋转、甜蜜茶话会，许愿这一切都永远不要结束。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Lilting music, dreamy spins, and a sweet tea party… I wish this party would never end.

IconDesc.SourceString: 乘上云间观光号热气球，从甜蜜的蛋糕山起飞，向着噗卡世界的天空缓缓前进！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Climb aboard the Cloud-Chasing Tour hot-air balloon, take off from sweet Cakehill, and drift slowly into the skies above Puka World!

IconDesc.SourceString: 等待惊喜噗卡公仔降临！说不定下一次抓到的就是你的命中注定！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A surprise Puka plushie is waiting! Your perfect match might be just one grab away!

IconDesc.SourceString: 瞄准、落爪、等待——心仪的玩偶就在眼前——等待，等待……？！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Line it up, drop the claw, and wait—your dream plushie is right there. Wait… wait… what?!

IconDesc.SourceString:
兑换心仪礼物与限定惊喜。
开启属于你的乐园冒险吧！
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
Redeem your favorite gifts and discover limited-time surprises.
Embark on your very own park adventure!

IconDesc.SourceString: 总有坏东西在觊觎炭团的收集品。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Something wicked always has its eye on Coal Lump's collection.

IconDesc.SourceString: 搭乘着虹彩珠光的贝母小舟，从噗卡乐园码头出发，沿着水岸慢悠悠巡游，沿途打卡乐园各个景点，享受一段松弛惬意的水上旅途
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Board a mother-of-pearl boat at Pukaland Pier and drift leisurely along the waterfront, taking in the park's sights along the way.

IconDesc.SourceString: 一个让平凡日子闪闪发亮的地方，一座充满欢笑与梦想的乐园。即便世界上有很多无法实现的愿望也没关系，在愿望交汇的地方，噗卡乐园永远敞开大门，等待下一场奇迹的发生。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: A place where ordinary days sparkle—a wonderland filled with laughter and dreams. Even if some wishes never come true, that's all right. Where wishes come together, the gates of Pukaland are always open, waiting for the next miracle.

IconDesc.SourceString: 母亲将我栽种到花园里，那里有温暖的阳光，甘甜的露水，有我的兄弟姊妹……可是母亲啊，人应该被栽种吗？
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Mother planted me in the Garden. The sunlight was warm, the dew was sweet, and my brothers and sisters were there… But Mother, are people meant to be planted?

IconDesc.SourceString: 库霸快递的物流中心，承担着货物分拣、车队调度和制定经营策略的职能。目标是称霸海特洛物流行业！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Kool Express's Logistics Hub handles cargo sorting, fleet dispatch, and strategic planning. Its goal? To dominate Hethereau's logistics industry!

IconDesc.SourceString: 库霸快递的物流中心，承担着货物分拣、车队调度和制定经营策略的职能。目标是称霸海特洛物流行业！
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Kool Express's Logistics Hub handles cargo sorting, fleet dispatch, and strategic planning. Its goal? To dominate Hethereau's logistics industry!

IconDesc.SourceString:
风平浪静的钓鱼点，是海特洛钓鱼高手们所青睐的场所。
不同的钓鱼点可以钓到的鱼有所不同，如果能正确地使用合适的鱼饵，可以更容易钓到想要的鱼。
IconDesc.LocalizedString:
A calm fishing spot favored by Hethereau's anglers.
Each spot attracts different fish, and using the right bait makes it easier to reel in your target catch.

IconDesc.SourceString: 车行老板是一位很会讲故事的大叔。在这里每辆车都有各自的故事，无论是真是假。比起车，大家对大叔本人的故事更好奇。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: The dealership owner is a gifted storyteller. Every car on the lot has a story, true or not. But people are even more curious about the man himself.

IconDesc.SourceString: 曾经号称是全市「最还原」的演训基地，百分百体验异象管理局的日常训练生活，在被证实为不实消息后弃用了。现在已经成为了暴走族的根据地。
IconDesc.LocalizedString: Once billed as the city's most realistic training facility, it promised to recreate the Bureau's daily drills with 100% accuracy. When the claim was exposed as false, the site was abandoned. It's now a biker gang hideout.
